label: Crouton Alpha
note: Free stealth model on OpenRouter (provider Stealth, listed since 2026-11-03), described there as a lightweight model for coding, agent sub-tasks, tool use and document analysis. Reads images, 1M window. In the VantheaX agent bench on 2026-11-07 it solved 8 of 9 tasks at high effort, about the level of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and somewhat faster. A stealth model can change or disappear without notice.
